<noinclude><pagequality level="1" user="" />{{rh|CHA. I.|ACCORDING TO S. IOHN.|217}}</noinclude>veritie.⊣ {{verse|chapter=1|verse=15}}† {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ He is preferred & made of more dignitie and excellencie then I, because he was before me & al things, eternal God.}}∷ Iohn giueth testimonie of him, and crieth saying, This vvas he of vvhom I spake, He that shal come after me, is made before me: because he vvas before me. {{verse|chapter=1|verse=16}}† And of his fulnes al vve haue receiued, and grace for grace. {{verse|chapter=1|verse=17}}† For the lavv vvas giuen by Moyses, grace and veritie vvas made by {{sc|Iesvs}} Christ. {{verse|chapter=1|verse=18}}† God {{sup|‖}} no man hath seen at any time: the only begotten Sonne vvhich is in the bosome of the father, he hath declared.

{{verse|chapter=1|verse=19}}† {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=The Gospel vpō the 3 Sunday in Aduent.}}And this is Iohns testimonie, vvhen the Ievves sent from Hierusalem Priests and Leuites to him, that they should aske him, VVho art thou? {{verse|chapter=1|verse=20}}† And he confessed, and did not denie: and he confessed, That I am not {{sc|Christ}}. {{verse|chapter=1|verse=21}}† And they asked him, VVhat then? Art thou {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Mal. 4, 5.''}}* Elias? And he said, I am not. Art thou {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Deu. 18, 15.''}}* {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ By like the Iewes ignorantly vnderstood not the place in Deuteronomie, of Christ, and therfore they aske also whether he be the Prophet there spoken of. See also c. 7, 40.}}∷ the Prophet? And he ansvvered, No. {{verse|chapter=1|verse=22}}† They said therefore vnto him, Vvho art thou, that vve may giue an ansvver to them that sent vs? vvhat saiest thou of thy self? {{verse|chapter=1|verse=23}}† He said, ''I am the voyce of one crying in the desert, make straight the vvay of our Lord'', {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Esa. 40, 3.''}}* as Esaie the Prophet said. {{verse|chapter=1|verse=24}}† And they that vvere sent, vvere of the Pharisees. {{verse|chapter=1|verse=25}}† And they asked him, and said to him, VVhy then doest thou baptize, if thou be not Christ, nor Elias, nor the Prophet? {{verse|chapter=1|verse=26}}† Iohn ansvvered them, saying, {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Mt. 3, 11. Mr. 1, 8. Lu. 3, 16.''}}* {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ He doth often here signifie the great difference of his baptisme & of Christs, as of his person & Christs. See Annot. Mat. 3.}}∷ I baptize in vvater: but there hath stood in the middes of you vvhom you know not. {{verse|chapter=1|verse=27}}† The same is he that shal come after me, that is made before me: vvhose latchet of his shoe I am not worthie to vnloose. {{verse|chapter=1|verse=28}}† These things were done in Bethania beyond Iordan, vvhere Iohn vvas baptizing.⊣

{{verse|chapter=1|verse=29}}† {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=The Gospel on the octaue of the Epiphanie.}}The next day Iohn savv {{sc|Iesvs}} comming to him, and he saith, {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ AGNVS DEI at Masse.}}∷ ''Behold the lambe of God, behold him that taketh avvay the'' {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''`sinnes''}}''`sinne''’ ''of the vvorld''. {{verse|chapter=1|verse=30}}† This is he of vvhom I said, After me there commeth a man, vvhich is made before me: because he vvas before me. {{verse|chapter=1|verse=31}}† And I knevv him not, but that he may be manifested in Israel, therefore came I baptizing in vvater. {{verse|chapter=1|verse=32}}† And Iohn gaue testimonie, saying, That I savv {{sup|‖}} the Spirit descending as a doue from heauen, and he remained vpon him. {{verse|chapter=1|verse=33}}† And I knevv him not: but he that sent me to baptize in vvater, he said to me, He vpon vvhom thou shalt see the Spirit descending and remaining vpon him, he it is that baptizeth in the holy Ghost. {{verse|chapter=1|verse=34}}† And I savv: and I gaue testimonie that this is the sonne of God.⊣

{{verse|chapter=1|verse=35}}† {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=The Gospel vpō S. Andrewes eue.}}The next day againe Iohn stoode, and tvvo of his disciples. {{verse|chapter=1|verse=36}}† And beholding {{sc|Iesvs}} vvalking, he saith, Behold<noinclude>{{rh||Ee|the}}</noinclude>
